job.title: Recruitment Operations Lead
job.description:
LOVE tech, process and people? Eager to shape how a boutique agency works behind the scenes and out front?

Then look no further….
  • Own our recruitment technology, from ATS and CRM, through to automation and system rollouts
  • Hands on leadership role - supporting the Director and Recruitment Manager
  • Full time, permanent position (open to 9 day fortnight)
  • CBD location with WFH flexibility after the probation period
  • Attractive salary package on offer 
  • Work in a fun, dynamic culture
  • Morning teas, lunches and company events & activities
  • Learning and professional development opportunities

About Us

Hugo Personnel is an Australian owned and managed, corporate recruitment agency. We work alongside our sister company, Inter Staffing Services, to provide temporary and permanent staff to our exceptional partners. We recruit in the areas of finance and accounting, administration and office support, call centre and customer service, human resources, and marketing and communications.

Our office is located right in the heart of the CBD, very close to public transport, with work from home flexibility after the probation period.


The Role

Reporting to the Director and Recruitment Manager, you will be the champion user of our core recruitment systems. You will review and refine our tech stack, lead rollouts and training, keep our data clean and compliant, and bring the team along for the ride. You will also draw on your recruitment knowledge to support our consultants, step in on escalations and occasionally recruit senior roles.

Your main responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Review and refine the company tech stack, lead system rollouts and integrations 
  • Act as champion user and first point of contact for all recruitment systems 
  • Analyse recruitment processes and workflows, and find opportunities for automation and optimisation
  • Facilitate onboarding and training for new and existing staff, including the leadership team
  • Refine training collateral, automation templates and instructional design packages
  • Assist with internal recruitment for new team members
  • Maintain data hygiene and produce ATS reports
  • Support weekly social media content, create EDMs, nurture pathways and marketing analytics
  • Support the Recruitment Manager with higher duties, senior role recruitment and client escalations
  • Collaborate with the Directors, IT Manager and Payroll Manager to manage our software vendors
What you need to succeed?
  • Demonstrated experience in a Recruitment Operations role, or a recruitment background with operations or systems leadership
  • Proven experience rolling out a CRM, ATS or HRIS
  • Strong working knowledge of an ATS and CRM, including automation builders or APIs, and the confidence to train others
  • Strong influencing skills, with the ability to bring stakeholders into change
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience facilitating workshops and training for staff at all levels
  • Sound understanding of compliance in a recruitment setting
  • Ability to adapt when priorities change, including balancing the needs of two businesses
  • Understanding of marketing and brand awareness (not essential)
Come join our close knit and energetic team who work hard but also have a lot of fun and laughs along the way.

Interviews will be held immediately.

job.title: Recruitment Coordinator
job.description:
Do you love working with people and enjoy the admin and operations behind recruitment? Then look no further...

  • Work for a reputable values-based community organisation that will make your days purposeful and rewarding
  • Monday – Friday in the office
  • 9am - 5pm  
  • Temporary position till the end of the year with a view for extension or to go permanent
  • Attractive salary + super
  • Be part of a HR and Talent team who prioritises respect, support and a fun culture
  • Strong company values such as innovation, customer focus, accountability and excellence
  • West Footscray location - close to public transport and free onsite parking
  • Working across a range of diverse roles
  
The Company 

You will be working for a reputable organisation who provide choices for people with a disability, enabling them to regain and retain their independence within an inclusive community. Their head office is based in the Western Suburbs of Melbourne, with public transport close by.
  
The Role

Reporting into the Talent Acquisition Lead, you will be responsible for coordinating administration recruitment activities across a range of internal vacancies, supporting hiring managers throughout the recruitment and onboarding process, and ensuring a seamless candidate experience.

Additionally, you will:

  • Manage the coordination and scheduling of candidate interviews with hiring managers

  • Coordinate staff and candidate enquiries to ensure timely responses throughout on boarding processes
  • Assist with employee on-boarding documentation for new hire such as background and VEVO checks, contracts and letters of offers, ensuring a smooth transition
  • Maintain strong and professional relationships with key external stakeholders
  • Ensure a positive and seamless candidate experience that contributes to overall organisation culture
  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the online recruitment system

What will you need to succeed? 
  • Proven experience in an Internal Talent/Recruitment Administration role
  • Experience in NFP, Healthcare or Disability services preferred but not essential
  • Understanding of employment legislation and compliance requirements 
  • Ability to multitask and prioritise workloads to meet deadlines
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with a customer centric approach
  • Both Working with Children Check and NDIS Clearance check are required

Please apply now if you are keen to join this people focused organisation. Interviews will be held immediately.

job.title: Events Operations Coordinator
job.description:
Are you an Events Coordinator/ Event Administrator eager to take your next step in an event based not-for-profit organisation? Look no further, we have the role for you!
  • Work in a values driven NFP organisation that aims to change the lives of young people
  • Work on large scale events, meaningful events with thousands of attendees
  • Work with an experienced mentor with a wealth of knowledge 
  • CBD location - accessible by public transport
  • Work from home flexibility - 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
  • Full time, permanent position 
  • Work in a high performing, 'all hands on deck' collaborative culture
  
The Company
Work for national not-for-profit which drives the success of young people. The organisation aims to showcase and promote excellence through programs, competitions, community projects and education pathways around Australia.
  
The Role
Working closely with the Head of Event Operations, you will be responsible for the coordination of the organisation's events, activities and programs. You will ensure that organisational activities are achieved in line with strategy, budget and time constraints. 

Your duties will include but not be limited to:
  • Coordinate local, state and interstate events and programs
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date event, volunteer and participant records within event management systems
  • Manage volunteer and participant engagement, communication and compliance requirements
  • Act as a primary point of contact for volunteers and key event stakeholders 
  • Support volunteer and participant logistics, including uniforms, travel, accommodation and on-site requirements
  • Liaise with venues, suppliers, contractors and key stakeholders to ensure successful program delivery
  • Obtain quotes and assist with financial administration to ensure accurate reporting of event related expenses
  • Provide on-site operational support during events, ensuring volunteers are fully briefed
  • Complete a high volume of administration, including database management and the ongoing maintenance of procedures, templates and operational documentation
What will you need to succeed?
  • Demonstrated experience in an Events Operations Coordinator/ Event Administrator position
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills
  • Strong project management, administrative and database management
  • Experience with event management or project management systems
  • Organisational skills, time management and ability to work to strict deadlines 
  • Budgeting, planning and project delivery skills 
  • Be a self starter who can work both autonomously and in a team environment
  • Ability to make considered decisions in a fast paced environment
Don't miss out on this excellent opportunity. Interviews will be held immediately.

Good luck!

job.title: Talent Acqusition Specialist
job.description:
Are you eager to be part of an organisation that is truly making a difference to our community?

• Talent Acquisition across a Victorian portfolio
• VERY attractive salary + salary packaging benefits on offer
• Work from home flex - 4 days in the office, 1 day from home
• Full-time permanent opportunity
• Beautiful, refurbished offices, central CBD location
• Access to EAP and FREE health and well-being initiatives on site
• Access to insurance discounts, school holiday programs and car hire
• Professional development and career progression opportunities
• Diverse, inclusive and strong team culture

The Company

An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced and dynamic Talent Acquisition Specialist to join a highly regarded, values driven not-for-profit organisation delivering services across disability, aged care and retirement living. Their stunning offices are close to public transport, with retail shops, restaurants and public transport at walking distance. Our client fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture, empowering their people while investing in capability and continuous development.

The Role

Reporting to the GM of Talent Acquisition, you'll take ownership of end-to-end recruitment across a dedicated healthcare portfolio. You'll partner closely with hiring managers, build talent pipelines, and provide market insights that support informed hiring decisions.

Your duties will also include:

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including job advertising, candidate screening, and interviewing
• Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, providing market insight and recruitment advice to influence hiring outcomes
• Conduct reference checks, compliance screening, and pre-employment checks
• Prepare contracts, offer letters, and onboarding paperwork to ensure a seamless candidate experience
• Proactively source and engage talent through multiple channels, including recruitment platforms, databases, networking, and headhunting
• Build and maintain talent pipelines to support your portfolio
• Deliver a positive and seamless candidate experience that reflects the organisation's culture
• Optimise Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment technology to improve recruitment outcomes and reporting

What do you need to succeed?

• Proven experience in an internal Talent Acquisition, Recruitment Advisor or Recruitment Partner role
• Experience recruiting within the NFP, healthcare or disability sectors is highly regarded, but not essential
• Strong strategic capability, with the ability to identify and engage talent across multiple channels in competitive candidate markets
• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
• Exceptional stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of the business


Interviews will be held immediately. Goodluck!

job.title: Payroll Specialist
job.description:
In between roles and seeking a contract position to take you up until Jan and potentially beyond? Then look no further
  • Join a highly regarded, values driven not-for-profit organisation who specialise in disability and aged care
  • Fast-paced varied position that will keep you on your toes
  • Full time, contract role for at least 2-3 months
  • Opportunity for extension or permanency for the right candidate!
  • Attractive hourly rate on offer!
  • 9am - 5pm or 8.30am - 4.30pm
  • WFH flexibility- 1 day a week!
  • Beautiful refurbished offices, central CBD location
  • Work within a collaborative & high performing people services team 

The Company

A exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Payroll Officer to join a highly regarded, values driven not-for-profit organisation delivering services across disability, aged care and retirement living. Their stunning offices are close to public transport, with retail shops, restaurants and public transport at walking distance. You will be required to work four days in the office and 1 day from home after training.

  
The Role

Reporting to the General Manager of Payroll, and working alongside three other Payroll Officers, this position will be responsible for accurate and timely processing of fortnightly payroll for over 3000 staff.
 
Key responsibilities will include:
  • End-to-end processing of fortnightly payroll for a large employee base
  • Maintain payroll systems and manage payroll records including leave, overtime and entitlements
  • Interpret relevant Awards, EBAs and contracts (including shift penalties and allowances)
  • Process terminations, variations, increases and backpay adjustments
  • Reconcile superannuation, WorkCover and other statutory deductions
  • Process salary packaging and liaise with external providers
  • Deliver accurate reporting to meet internal and legislative requirements
  • Champion service excellence, ensuring all payroll enquiries are handled promptly, accurately and with care
  • Partner closely with HR to ensure accurate, compliant employee set-up and continuous process improvement
  
What are we looking for?
  • Proven experience in a high-volume payroll position for a diverse workforce
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Business/Accounting/Finance or related fields would be desirable
  • Experience working within the health care/aged care/disability industries will be high desirable but not essential 
  • Strong Knowledge of awards, EBA's, Fair Work Act and employment agreements
  • Experience using payroll software systems, ideally SuccessFactors
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to liaise with a variety of stakeholders
  • Advanced Ms Excel and systems savvy
  • Strong attention to detail with good accuracy 
  • Adaptable, positive and has a desire to grow!
     
Please apply now. Interviews will be held immediately.

job.title: Personal Assistant
job.description:
Are you an experienced PA/Senior Administrator/Team Coordinator ready to take the next step in your career and move into an Executive Assistant role?
  • Work for a highly regarded organisation within the health and research sector
  • Exciting opportunity to take the next step from Senior Administration into an EA role
  • Varied traditional role supporting a COO with the opportunity to gain valuable C-Suite exposure
  • Attractive salary package on offer
  • Camberwell location – free car parking and close to public transport
  • Monday - Friday, 8.00 - 4.30pm
  • RDO'S every month
  • Free coffee, fruit and snacks!
  • Lots of learning & development opportunities
  • Purpose-driven organisation making a genuine difference to healthier communities
  • Modern offices with a supportive & collaborative culture
  
The Company

There is an exciting opportunity for a self-motivated and experienced Administration professional to join a highly regarded organisation operating within the health and research sector. Renowned for its commitment to innovation and excellence, the organisation plays a key role in delivering projects that make a meaningful impact on people's lives. This position is based at their head office in Camberwell, conveniently located close to public transport, with car parking available on site.


The Role

This fantastic opportunity is a step up for someone who already has strong administration and coordination experience and is ready to take on more responsibility and work closely with senior Executives and develop their career as an EA.

Your main responsibility will be to provide executive administration support to the COO while also assisting with broader team coordination and other business activities. With ongoing support, you will bring your strong organisational skills and initiative to perform the following:
  • Manage the COO’s diary, calendar and inbox
  • Coordinate meetings, agendas, papers, minutes and follow-up actions
  • Prepare presentations, reports and executive briefing documents
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel, accommodation and itineraries
  • Manage correspondence and communications
  • Coordinate document approvals and execution
  • Liaise with Executives, Board members, clients and external stakeholders
  • Support office and team administration, including onboarding and supplier coordination
  • Assist with building, facilities and other office administration duties
  • Maintain effective filing and document management systems
  • Anticipate the COO’s needs, use your initiative and proactively solve problems
  
What will you need to succeed?
  • Proven experience in a Senior Administration, Team Coordinator or PA role
  • Experience coordinating diaries, meetings, events, projects or senior stakeholders
  • Advanced MS Office and systems skills
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted relationships
  • Ability to juggle multiple priorities and be agile in an ever-changing environment
  • A proactive, can-do approach with the confidence to use your initiative
  • Most importantly, the drive, desire and enthusiasm to learn, grow and take the next step in your EA career!
